svg.text: Illustration only: the schematics and docs/box-connectors.md are the source of truth. Board layouts for B are not done yet.
dingoPDM v7.5 based - 8 outputs at 7.5 A
J6 - JST GH 12-pin (to its input board)
dingoPDM-Max based - 4 outputs at 31 A + 4 at 15 A
OUT1-8 - bolt-down terminals (Wuerth REDCUBE M4), one wire each
J6 - Molex Micro-Fit 2x2 (CAN and the 2 stock inputs)
J7 - JST GH 12-pin, top entry (to its input board)
Input board (x3: one per main board)
protects the inputs and holds the pull-up / pull-down switches
J1 - JST GH 12-pin (to the main board)
J2 - Molex Micro-Fit 2x6 (wires to enclosure connector X2)
Board A uses channels 1-5 (its IN3-IN7). Board B uses all 8 (its IN3-IN10).
